import type {
  BashToolDetails,
  ExtensionAPI,
  ToolDefinition,
} from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";

import { createBashToolDefinition } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
import { Type } from "typebox";

/**
 * Pi's own `bash` tool takes a command and a timeout, so a surface reading a pi
 * run has nothing to head a tool row with except the command, which is a wall of
 * flags where a reader wants an action. This extension overrides `bash` with
 * pi's own execution and one parameter more, the one-line summary the model
 * already knows and other harnesses already send. It defines no renderers, so pi
 * keeps rendering the call itself and an interactive pi session looks unchanged.
 *
 * The module is embedded byte-for-byte as its `.ts.txt` twin and runs inside pi
 * rather than inside ori, so it may import nothing but pi's own surface.
 */
const bashParameters = Type.Object({
  command: Type.String({ description: "Bash command to execute" }),
  description: Type.Optional(
    Type.String({
      description:
        "Short imperative summary of what this command does, five to ten words, shown to the person in place of the command (for example 'Start the dev server')",
    })
  ),
  timeout: Type.Optional(
    Type.Number({
      description: "Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)",
    })
  ),
});

// The cwd pi's definition is built with reaches nothing but its `execute`, and
// each call runs against the cwd pi resolves for that call instead, so the
// definition every other field is read from is built with a cwd never used.
const UNUSED_CWD = "";
const CALL_CONTEXT = 4;

const summarizedBashTool = (): ToolDefinition<
  typeof bashParameters,
  BashToolDetails | undefined
> => {
  // Pi's own definition minus the argument shim typed against its narrower
  // schema, which pi does not set for bash anyway. Everything else, the label,
  // the description and both renderers, stays pi's.
  const { prepareArguments: _shim, ...inherited } =
    createBashToolDefinition(UNUSED_CWD);
  return {
    ...inherited,
    execute: (...call) =>
      createBashToolDefinition(call[CALL_CONTEXT].cwd).execute(...call),
    parameters: bashParameters,
    promptGuidelines: [
      ...(inherited.promptGuidelines ?? []),
      "Always pass `description` to `bash`. It heads the tool row the person reads, so say what the command accomplishes rather than how.",
    ],
    promptSnippet:
      "bash(command, description, timeout?) - Run a shell command, described in a few words",
  };
};

const register = (pi: ExtensionAPI): void => {
  pi.registerTool(summarizedBashTool());
};

export { bashParameters, register, summarizedBashTool };
export default register;
